paper.title_en: Black holes with quantum corrections in $3d$: The case of Page curve in Lindblad, greybody factor, and Lyapunov exponent
paper.abstract_en: In this work, first we discuss black holes with quantum corrections as an open quantum system and apply Lindblad formalism to explain the ``zig-zag" behavior in the Hawking- Page curve and radiation process, specially by considering the effects of exceptional points. Then, we calculate quantum corrections for various parameters of $3d$ Cotler-Jensen theory which is $\text{AdS}_3$ with reparametrized modes. At each step of the calculations, we compare the results with the case of JT. We then calculate quantum-corrected greybody factor for various black hole solutions, and specially for the case of Cotler-Jensen theory. Finally, we study the effects of quantum corrections on Lyapunov exponent, potential, and quantum information structure of black holes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将量子修正黑洞作为开放量子系统处理，结合Lindblad形式、例外点、Page曲线、Cotler-Jensen理论、灰体因子与Lyapunov指数等多个理论物理前沿概念，理论深度较高，方法上具有多步骤解析计算的严谨性信号，且选题涉及黑洞热力学与信息结构，适合进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 三维量子修正黑洞：Lindblad、灰体因子与Lyapunov指数中的Page曲线案例
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们首先将带有量子修正的黑洞作为开放量子系统进行讨论，并应用Lindblad形式来解释Hawking-Page曲线和辐射过程中的“之字形”行为，特别是考虑例外点的影响。然后，我们计算三维Cotler-Jensen理论（即带重参数化模式的AdS₃）中各种参数的量子修正。在计算的每一步，我们都将结果与JT的情况进行比较。接着，我们计算各种黑洞解的量子修正灰体因子，特别是针对Cotler-Jensen理论的情况。最后，我们研究量子修正对Lyapunov指数、势以及黑洞量子信息结构的影响。
